source: ## Runs 6–7 — raw spot checks, onset and FFT stability

The electron trace reaches the high-density discrimination window; the hole trace is limited to the near-CNP exception regime by the TG fence. Low-field samples in run 6 below 1 T fail the fastest-tone Nyquist criterion, so onset is evaluated only above that edge. The carrying tone is censored there: take a finely sampled low-field extension before the fan. These are positive-field traces; no even-in-B separation is available.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, sdh_fft

for fid, density, blo in [(6,3.2,1.0),(7,-1.2,0.72)]:
    r=open_run(Path('data')/str(fid))
    fig=plot_raw(r); fig.suptitle(f'Run {fid}: raw signed Rxx and measured current'); fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot_{fid}_raw.png'); plt.show()
    chans=resolve_channels(r.meta); cur=current_channel(chans); v=next(c for c in chans if c.cid=='sr1')
    I=r.col(cur.col)/cur.gain; R=(r.col(v.col)/v.gain)/I; B=r.col('magnet_field')
    on=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=blo,r_full_scale=5000)
    print(f'Run {fid}, n={density}e12, D=0\n'+on.summary())
    print(f'R={R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} Ohm; I={I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA; T={r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K')
    fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
    for deg in [3,5,7]:
        f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(max(blo,on.onset_b),10),bg_degree=deg,log=False)
        axs[0].plot(f,sp[0]/sp[0].max(),label=f'polynomial {deg}')
        pk,_=find_peaks(sp[0]); pk=[p for p in pk if 3<f[p]<50]
        print('degree',deg,'candidate peaks',[(round(float(f[p]),2),round(float(sp[0,p]/sp[0].max()),2)) for p in sorted(pk,key=lambda p:-sp[0,p])[:6]])
    for t in on.tones[:4]: axs[1].plot(t.b_centers,t.snr,label=f'{t.freq:.1f} T')
    axs[0].axvline(abs(density)*10.339169,color='k',ls=':',label='F_L geometry prior')
    axs[0].set(xlim=(0,50),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT magnitude',title=f'Run {fid}: stability, signed R (no log)')
    axs[1].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':'); axs[1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Matched-filter SNR',title='Per-tone onset tracking')
    for ax in axs: ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot_{fid}_fft.png'); plt.show()
print('Interpretation: oscillations are present on both sides, but the low-edge carrying tone is censored on the Nyquist-valid record. Electron range reaches the discriminating high-density regime; hole range does not. No stacking verdict yet. Low-field electron extension is required before committing the fan. Positive-B-only records are not even-in-B; Hall/contact admixture remains a hedge. Harmonic flags alone cannot remove a candidate partition branch; density trajectories will decide.')

## HERA — resolve the censored electron onset before the fan

> **05:21** · SdH onset extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0; B .3->1.6 T, 301 inverse-B points; sr1 5uV; base T · **ETA ~05:51** (≈30 min)

`sdh-spot-check` and `landau-fan-vti` require an onset measured on an adequately sampled record. Run 6 has 50 mT spacing below 1 T: it cannot Nyquist-resolve F_L=33.09 T there. Restricted to B>=1 T, `sdh_onset` finds a censored 7.3 T candidate (also near the background-residual band); the 22.3/29.4 T candidates start near 1.40/1.76 T. This short extension tests the low-field candidate and overlaps the original record before we price the fan; no stacking interpretation is attached to a harmonic flag.

Same n=+3.2e12, D=0, run-5 calibration and 10 nA drive. Uniform inverse-B grid .3->1.6 T, 301 rows: du=.00903/T (3.35 points per 33.09 T period; >=2 even at +20% scale and the secondary-ridge density offset). Full scale 500 Ohm at sr1 5 uV clears run-6 low-field maximum ~60 Ohm. Driver settle 3 s is 10 tau; no extra dwell. Run 6/7 measured point overhead beyond the .137 T/min ramp is ~3.08 s; 301 points cost 15.5 min plus 11.7 min total positioning/traverse and setup, budget 30 min. Leaves B=1.6 T and gates at the spot for the fan. Read-only preconditions compare all validators with the card, base-T freshness, heater/PS/output, drive, Si, wiring and pacing. Every followed channel is plotted; leakage/current/temperature/rail guards stop the sweep. Read first 20 points and completion with hera-watch.

# Read-only preconditions before any instrument set.
for label, p, expected in [
    ('TG',k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)),('BG',k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
    ('Si',dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),('Si raw',dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
    ('B',magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),('T sample',heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
    ('T vaporizer',heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(float(p.vals._min_value),float(p.vals._max_value))
    print(label,'validator expected',expected,'actual',actual)
    assert actual==expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10. and T_SESSION_CAP==100.
assert (k_tg is k_2400_tg) and (k_bg is k_2400_bg) and (k_si is dc205.smart_voltage)
for name in ['T_sample','T_vaporizer']:
    assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_ts,_tv,_b=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field()
print('Expected base Ts 1.0-1.5 K, Tv <1.6 K, B near 0 T; actual',_ts,_tv,_b)
assert 1.0<=_ts<=1.5 and 0.5<_tv<1.6 and abs(_ts-_tv)<0.6
assert abs(_b)<0.05
_hr=(heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range())
_ps=(magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled())
print('Expected heaters (0,0), PS/output (True,True); actual',_hr,_ps)
assert _hr==(0,0) and all(_ps)
_si=(dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output(),k_si(),dc205.ramp_rate)
print('Expected Si range2/on/0V/0.5V/s; actual',_si)
assert _si[:2]==(2,1) and abs(_si[2])<.01 and _si[3]==.5
_drive=(sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency())
print('Expected drive 1 V,13.777 Hz; actual',_drive)
assert abs(_drive[0]-1)<1e-6 and abs(_drive[1]-13.777)<.01
for li in [sr0,sr1]:
    settings=(li.time_constant(),li.filter_slope())
    print(li.name,'expected tau0.3/slope24; actual',settings)
    assert settings==(.3,24)
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005
print('NPLC expected 1,1; actual',k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
print('Expected hardwired B1-B2 / T0-B3; actual',WIRING)
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
vt,vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
assert -.3<=vt<=1. and -1.3<=vb<=2.
B_extension=field_invB(.3,1.6,301)
print('Extension 301 rows, du',np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_extension))))
mc=dict(meas_config); mc.update({'Si (V)':k_si(),'sample_temperature:':_ts,'comments':'onset extension n=3.2e12 D=0, B=.3->1.6T uniform inverse B; run6 calibration; sr1 5uV'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment('onset extension: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0; B .3->1.6T 301 uniform-inverse-B; sr1 5uV; 3s driver settle; no gate pacing changes')
sr1.sensitivity(5e-6)
assert sr0.sensitivity()==.02 and magnet.settle_s>=3.
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,vb); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,vt)
interruptible_sleep(3)
# Total field positioning + traverse 1.6/.137=11.7 min, no return leg.
magnet.field(.3)
params=[T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]
for p in params:
    s.fp(p); s.plot('time',p)
def extension_guard(station,data):
    a=np.asarray(data[2:],float)
    if (not np.all(np.isfinite(a)) or not 1.0<=a[0]<=1.5 or not .5<a[1]<1.6
        or max(abs(a[2]),abs(a[3]))>1e-9 or abs(a[6])>.9*5e-6
        or not 8e-9<=a[4]/-1e6<=12e-9):
        print('EXTENSION GUARD STOP',data); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(extension_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_extension,delay=0)
print('Extension final actual state B/TG/BG:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
